title: Sr Associate, Cyber Sec Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
For more than a century, Northern Trust has worked hard building our legacy of outstanding service, expertise and integrity. From a Chicago-based bank founded in 1889, we now have more than 20 international locations and 18,500 employees globally. We serve the world’s most-sophisticated clients – from sovereign wealth funds and the wealthiest individuals and families, to the most-successful hedge funds and corporate brands.
  
  
We burnished our reputation as a global leader delivering innovative investment management, asset and fund administration, fiduciary and banking solutions enabled by sophisticated, leading technology. And through it all, we continually laid a solid, forward-looking foundation on which future generations can continue growing and achieving greater.
  
  
Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Oracle SaaS Cloud Security - Consultant
description:

**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
Enterprise Security:
  
  
Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration & Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement.
  
  
Level: Consultant

As a Consultant, you will be supporting the team/clients with their Cyber needs specifically helping them address Application Security concerns and navigate the journey on the Oracle Platform. This will include:
  
  

* Design, and implement customized, scalable and SOX compliant security solutions
* Advanced debugging and troubleshoot issues, including interacting with technology vendors
* Identify, design, customize and implement Oracle Risk Management Cloud Controls as part of Governance, Risk and Compliance solution
* Attend client design workshop sessions, design documentation by conducting workshops in onsite/offshore delivery model for projects

**Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* At least 3-4 years of experience delivering full cycle of Oracle Cloud Security assessments, design, and implementations as well as understanding of leading practices relates to ERP security

* Experience in securing Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) reports/data models/subject areas/analysis
* Experience in coordinating with development teams, functional teams, business leads, information security & risk management teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Experience in Oracle GRC or Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) design, implementation or assessment experience including Advanced Access Controls (AAC), Advanced Financial Controls (AFC) and Financial Reporting Compliance (FRC)

* Previous Consulting or Big 4 experience preferred
* Security Certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CISA is a plus
* Automation using Python, C#, or VBA
* Troubleshooting and analytical skills using PL-SQL queries

title: Exposure Management Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a cybersecurity professional with strong experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment, infrastructure security, security operations, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be comfortable communicating with both technical teams and executive leadership while driving measurable reductions in organizational cyber risk.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management**

title: Security Analyst
description:
Job Description: Security Analyst – Endpoint Security, SIEM & Vulnerability Management

Location: Pune/Noida/Bangalore, India

Experience 2–5 years

Department IT Infrastructure & Information Security

Employment Full-time

About Onextel

Onextel Limited delivers enterprise communication technology and CPaaS solutions including SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Voice, RCS, Email and telecom messaging infrastructure to enterprises, financial institutions and government organizations.

Role Overview

We seek a hands-on Security Analyst to monitor and strengthen cybersecurity across enterprise endpoints, Windows/Linux servers, virtualized infrastructure and networks. The role covers SIEM monitoring, EDR/XDR investigation, vulnerability tracking, incident response and remediation coordination, working closely with Infrastructure, Network and Development teams.

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & SIEM Operations

* Monitor events using Microsoft Sentinel, Wazuh, ELK Stack, Splunk or equivalent SIEM platforms.
* Analyze and correlate Windows, Linux, endpoint, firewall and network logs; investigate suspicious activity and unauthorized access.
* Develop and tune detection queries and rules (including KQL), reduce false positives and maintain dashboards.

Endpoint Detection & Response

* Monitor, configure and administer EDR/XDR and antivirus solutions such as Microsoft Defender XDR or CrowdStrike.
* Investigate malware, phishing, suspicious processes, ransomware indicators and endpoint compromises.
* Monitor agent health, coverage and updates; troubleshoot agents and coordinate isolation, containment and recovery.

Vulnerability & Patch Management

* Identify and track CVEs, missing patches, insecure configurations and vulnerabilities using Qualys, Nessus, OpenVAS or equivalent tools.
* Prioritize findings by CVSS, exploitability and asset criticality; coordinate remediation and validate closure.
* Maintain vulnerability registers, patch compliance dashboards and remediation reports.

Security Incident Response & Investigation

* Triage and investigate brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, malware and suspicious authentication events.
* Analyze email headers, IPs, domains and IOCs using VirusTotal, AlienVault OTX, MISP and other intelligence sources.
* Apply MITRE ATT&CK and Cyber Kill Chain concepts; document incident classification, escalation, RCA and closure.

Linux, Windows & Infrastructure Security

* Analyze operating-system authentication logs, processes, access controls, ports and network connections.
* Support Linux/Windows hardening, CIS baseline reviews, server security and virtualized infrastructure security.
* Coordinate remediation of insecure services, outdated packages and unauthorized changes.

Network & Firewall Security

* Review firewall, VPN, IDS/IPS and network logs for scanning, malicious traffic and unauthorized connections.
* Use TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH and HTTP/HTTPS fundamentals to investigate incidents.
* Coordinate firewall rule reviews, malicious-IP blocking and network containment with administrators.

Threat Intelligence & Automation

* Perform IOC enrichment, basic threat hunting and threat-intelligence monitoring.
* Use Python, PowerShell or Bash to automate log analysis, checks, alert triage and reporting.

Reporting, Compliance & Governance

* Prepare daily monitoring summaries and weekly/monthly security posture reports.
* Maintain incident records, vulnerability trackers, SOPs and escalation workflows.
* Support ISO 27001 controls, audit evidence, security policy compliance and corrective-action tracking.

Required Technical Skills

* SIEM: Microsoft Sentinel, Wazuh, ELK Stack, Splunk or equivalent; KQL, log correlation
* Endpoint: Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR/XDR; endpoint security
* Operating systems: Windows, Windows Server, Linux/Ubuntu; security log and process analysis
* Incident response: Alert triage, phishing/malware investigation, escalation, containment and RCA
* Vulnerabilities: CVE/CVSS, vulnerability scanning, patch management and remediation tracking
* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH, VPN and firewall fundamentals
* Threat intelligence: MITRE ATT&CK, IOCs, VirusTotal, MISP or equivalent
* Automation: Python, PowerShell or Bash

Good-to-Have Skills

* DLP and MDM/UEM
* Netskope CASB/SWG
* Fortinet firewalls
* Proxmox virtualization
* CIS hardening
* IDS/IPS
* Zero Trust
* SOAR
* ISO 27001

Qualifications & Certifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Cybersecurity or a related discipline
* Minimum 2 years of relevant cybersecurity or infrastructure security experience.
* Preferred (not mandatory): Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA Security+/CySA+, Splunk, Qualys, Cisco cybersecurity or CEH certifications.

Key Performance Indicators

* Endpoint and server security monitoring coverage and agent health.
* Timely identification, investigation and escalation of security alerts.
* Accuracy and completeness of incident investigations and documentation.
* Vulnerability and patch remediation tracking against agreed SLAs.
* Quality of security reports, detection tuning and operational improvements.

Candidate Profile

A proactive analyst with practical SIEM, EDR, Windows/Linux log analysis, vulnerability management and investigation experience. Willingness to build further hands-on capability in enterprise DLP, MDM and security platform administration is desirable.

description:

At CellPoint Digital, we’re revolutionizing the way businesses in the air, travel, and hospitality sectors manage their payments.

With our
**Leading Payment Orchestration Platform**
, we’re turning payments into a strategic advantage, helping clients optimize their payment experience to boost profits, maximize approvals, lower costs and take control of their payment, resulting in more money to the bottom line.

**strategic asset**

**profit engine**
, turning every transaction into an opportunity for growth and competitive advantage.

At our core,
**we're innovators**
and
**problem-solvers**
united by five key values: Mission First, Ownership, Trust & Transparency, Driven, and One Team. We're ambitious professionals who embrace accountability and transform payments together.

Our diverse community spans the globe, with hubs in Copenhagen, Dallas, Dubai, London, Miami, Pune, Buenos Aires, Bogota, Mexico, and Singapore, along with remote team members worldwide. We celebrate the unique perspectives and experiences that make our team extraordinary.

Join us as a
**Security Engineer**
on our mission to turn payments into possibilities!

Location: India Industry: Fintech / Payment Orchestration

**Security Engineer**

Join CellPoint Digital as a Security Engineer. You are the builder and the mechanic of our security ecosystem. Your mission is to turn architectural designs into high-performing, automated reality. In our 1-2-2 team model, you provide the technical "muscle" that allows our Architects to maintain compliance and our Lead to drive strategy.

You will be on the front lines of several critical greenfield projects: implementing our Just-In-Time (JIT) access platform, technically configuring our SIEM/SOAR within Google Cloud, and—crucially—automating our compliance evidence collection via the Sprinto GRC platform to eliminate manual toil. You are someone who believes that if a task has to be done twice, it should be scripted.

**How You Will Make an Impact:**

* Automation & GRC Engineering: Support the Senior Architects by building and maintaining API integrations between our tech stack and Sprinto. Your goal is to eliminate manual evidence collection by writing automation (Python/Go) that feeds real-time configuration data from GCP, GitHub, and CrowdStrike into the GRC platform.
* SIEM/SOAR Implementation (GCP SCC): Perform the technical setup and tuning of GCP Security Command Center. Build and maintain the automated "Playbooks" that allow our systems to self-remediate common security events (e.g., auto-isolating a compromised GKE pod).
* Zero-Trust & Identity Operations: Execute the technical rollout of Ploy (JIT). Manage the day-to-day health and tuning of our Twingate (ZTNA) connectors and JumpCloud policies to ensure seamless, secure access for a global team.
* Shift-Left & CI/CD Tuning: Maintain security scanners (SAST/DAST) within GitHub Actions. Work directly with developers to tune SonarCloud rules, reducing false positives and ensuring that the "Shift-Left" process is high-fidelity and low-friction.
* Operational Defense & MDR Support: Act as the primary technical responder for escalations from our CrowdStrike MDR service. Perform hands-on remediation, containment, and forensic investigation within the GCP environment.
* Resilience & DRP Execution: Build and maintain the automation scripts used for Disaster Recovery (DRP) failover. Lead regular "Game Day" exercises to ensure that our recovery procedures are functional, documented, and meet RTO/RPO targets.
* Automation Rate: Percentage of GRC evidence collected automatically via Sprinto APIs vs. manual uploads (Target: >80% of technical controls).
* Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR): Tracking the speed of resolving critical vulnerabilities identified by SonarCloud or GCP SCC.
* Tool Coverage: Ensuring 100% deployment of CrowdStrike and Twingate across all relevant endpoints and cloud workloads.
* DRP Readiness: Successful execution of technical recovery playbooks during scheduled Disaster Recovery tests.

**Skills you will have fine-tuned:**

* Experience: 4+ years of hands-on Security Engineering experience in a cloud-native (GCP preferred) environment.

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Server & Infrastructure Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support
  
  

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity
  
  

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management
  
  

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

* Architect and build cloud foundations and platform capabilities across client environments.

* Design resilience and continuity architecture, including backup/restore strategy and disaster recovery.
* Own and evolve infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices and tooling standards.

* Contribute to operational reporting quality, including platform health signals and SLA-relevant metrics.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as senior technical point of contact for client escalations requiring infrastructure or platform expertise.

* Cloud Architecture Expertise (Azure, AWS, or GCP)Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud platforms Define platform guardrails and architecture standards
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, or equivalent Building and maintaining automated infrastructure deployments

**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Sr. Infrastructure Analyst – Computing to support and improve enterprise IT infrastructure across global locations. 1The role covers Windows Server, virtualization and Nutanix AHV, storage, operating systems, infrastructure services, automation, monitoring, and advanced troubleshooting.
  
  
**Role Description**

* Analyze and recommend infrastructure solutions, upgrades, and services to streamline processes and improve systems.
* Perform hardware and software maintenance, including troubleshooting, installation, and upgrades.
* Conduct advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across compute, virtualization, storage, operating systems, networks, and infrastructure services.
* Provide infrastructure support to multiple locations worldwide.
* Deliver infrastructure implementations, upgrades, and technical projects, including testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational handover.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical documentation and provide advanced infrastructure support as required.
* Assist and coach other analysts on troubleshooting and fulfillment processes.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools for provisioning, patching, monitoring, validation, and remediation.
* Integrate infrastructure and operational data into Power BI for leadership and technical visibility.
* Improve monitoring signal-to-noise ratio through alert tuning, thresholds, and automation.

Support technical readiness and transition of new or upgraded platforms into operations
  
  
**Skill Requirements**
PRIMARY SKILLS (MUST HAVE SKILLS):
  
  

* Strong knowledge of Windows Server infrastructure and core enterprise services, including Active Directory, DNS, TCP/IP, and network fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise virtualization and HCI platforms such as Nutanix AHV, including lifecycle management, troubleshooting, capacity, performance, and availability.
* Working knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN/NAS, file services, capacity management, and storage performance.
* Operating system lifecycle management using tools such as WSUS or Tanium.
* Knowledge of security hardening based on established industry standards.
* Exposure to Linux operating systems.
* Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent.
* Ability to analyze infrastructure data and metrics to drive platform improvements.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure fundamentals.

**Secondary Skills (good To Have)**

* Administration and support experience with public cloud IaaS platforms; Microsoft Azure is a strong plus.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring and observability tools such as LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with Active Directory, DNS, LAN/Core Networking, server hardening, antivirus, SSO, MFA, or related security systems.
* Data protection (backup/restore) and/or disaster recovery solutions.
* Experience supporting hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.
* Experience using Git/GitHub for version control of scripts, configuration files, documentation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for infrastructure troubleshooting, automation, scripting, log analysis, and technical documentation.
* Experience with REST APIs for integrating, querying, or automating infrastructure platforms and services.
* Familiarity with JSON and webhooks and their use in infrastructure automation and system integrations

**Working Pattern and Coverage**

* Hybrid working pattern, with a combination of office and remote work.
* Workdays are Sunday to Thursday.
* Standard shift is approximately 7:00 PM–4:00 AM ET (4:30 AM–1:30 PM India time).
* Thursday hours are adjusted to allow participation in the team call.
* Sunday shift must overlap with existing coverage ending at 8:30 AM ET.
* Must be able to work on shifts if required.

**Qualifications And Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent, preferred.
* Relevant infrastructure certifications such as Microsoft, Nutanix, VMware, Cisco, or equivalent are preferred.

**Additional Notes**

* This is a senior infrastructure support role requiring advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
* The analyst will support infrastructure services across multiple global locations.
* Automation, monitoring improvements, documentation, and operational readiness are important parts of the role.

title: Analyst II, Production Support
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**SITE RELIABILITY & CLOUD ENGINEER**
**Production Engineering | Pune, India**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
Engineer reliable, secure and scalable cloud services by combining production operations with software engineering, automation, observability and cloud platform expertise. The role owns service reliability outcomes across the application lifecycle and partners with development, infrastructure, security and support teams to prevent incidents, reduce toil and improve customer experience.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability and Cloud Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS and/or Microsoft Azure. The successful candidate will design, deploy, operate and continuously improve production services, with a focus on availability, performance, resilience, security and operational efficiency.
  
  
This is an engineering-led production role. The engineer will use automation, infrastructure as code, telemetry and disciplined incident/problem management to create sustainable services, accelerate safe change and reduce manual operational effort.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the reliability, availability, performance and operational readiness of cloud-hosted applications and platform services
* Define and maintain service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs), availability targets and actionable service-health dashboards
* Build monitoring and alerting around customer-impacting symptoms, golden signals and service dependencies; reduce alert noise and improve diagnostic quality
* Automate repeatable operational work, remediation, deployments, configuration, evidence collection and environment validation using code and pipelines
* Design, build and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, reusable modules, policy guardrails and secure engineering standards
* Participate in incident response and on-call support, including rapid triage, stabilisation, technical escalation and clear stakeholder communication
* Lead or contribute to blameless post-incident reviews; identify root causes, track corrective actions and engineer controls that prevent recurrence
* Partner with application engineering teams on architecture, capacity planning, performance engineering, release readiness and production operability
* Improve deployment safety through CI/CD controls, automated testing, progressive validation, rollback strategies and change-risk reduction
* Engineer resilience through high-availability patterns, backup and restore validation, disaster-recovery runbooks, failover testing and dependency mapping
* Manage production risks including vulnerabilities, patching, certificates, secrets, access controls, audit evidence and cloud security findings
* Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, architecture records and operational knowledge that support consistent 24x7 service delivery
* Analyse operational data and trends to reduce mean time to detect and restore service, eliminate recurring failure modes and improve capacity and cost efficiency
* Mentor support and engineering colleagues in SRE practices, automation, observability, troubleshooting and operational ownership

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, production engineering, DevOps, platform engineering or Site Reliability Engineering
* Hands-on experience operating production workloads on AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including compute, networking, identity, storage, managed databases and monitoring services
* Strong Linux/UNIX administration and troubleshooting skills; working knowledge of Windows Server is beneficial
* Practical experience with Kubernetes and containers, including EKS and/or AKS, Docker, deployment troubleshooting and workload reliability
* Infrastructure-as-code experience using Terraform; ability to build reusable, governed and maintainable modules
* CI/CD experience with tools such as Harness, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or equivalent, including deployment and rollback controls
* Programming or advanced automation capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash or a comparable language; coding experience beyond simple one-off scripts
* Experience with observability platforms and practices covering metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting and application performance monitoring
* Strong incident and problem management experience, including technical triage, root cause analysis, corrective actions and production communications
* Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, high availability, capacity management, performance bottlenecks and failure modes
* Experience supporting SQL Server and cloud database services, including connectivity, performance diagnostics, backup/restore and operational monitoring
* Working knowledge of cloud security, least privilege, certificate and secrets management, vulnerability remediation, auditing and compliance controls
* Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform for incidents, problems, changes and operational work tracking
* Clear written and verbal communication, disciplined documentation, strong ownership and the ability to work across engineering and business teams

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Cloud certification in AWS or Microsoft Azure; Kubernetes or Terraform certification is advantageous
* Experience with Akamai, API gateways, web application delivery, DNS, load balancing, VPNs and enterprise network connectivity
* Knowledge of event-driven and service-oriented architectures, domain-driven design and messaging platforms
* Experience in regulated financial services or another environment with formal change, risk, audit, resilience and data-protection obligations
* Experience implementing policy as code, security scanning, automated compliance controls, FinOps or cloud cost optimisation
* Experience supporting globally distributed services, customer onboarding and follow-the-sun operational models

Success Measures
  
  
**Outcome**
**Evidence of Success**
**Reliability**
Services have defined health measures, meaningful alerts, tested recovery procedures and improving availability trends.
  
  
**Engineering efficiency**
Manual toil and recurring incidents are reduced through automation, reusable tooling and preventive engineering.
  
  
**Operational readiness**
Releases and services meet documented production-readiness, security, observability and support requirements.
  
  
**Incident learning**
Major incidents produce clear root causes, owned corrective actions and measurable risk reduction.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Development, platform, security and support teams share clear ownership and use consistent operational practices.
  
  
Role Expectations
  
  

* Location~ Pune, India
* Flexible to work on rotational shifts and weekends too
* Work closely with global engineering, production support, security and service-management teams
* Participate in an agreed on-call or out-of-hours support rotation where required for production services
* Demonstrate an engineering mindset~ automate where practical, design for failure, measure service health and treat operational learning as product improvement

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
  
  
**Sourcing Model**
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Staff InfoSec Engineer
description:
HMH is a learning technology company committed to delivering connected solutions that engage learners, empower educators and improve student outcomes. As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
  
  
HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
  
  
Join our Information Security team as a Staff Security Engineer with approximately 5–8 years of hands-on experience in cloud security, application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, and security automation. This role will help protect our cloud and on-premises environments and support the organization’s GovRAMP security and compliance program.
  
  
Responsibilities include implementing and monitoring cloud security controls, managing vulnerabilities and security alerts, supporting GovRAMP/NIST 800-53 controls, SSP, POA&M, evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and assessments, and driving remediation activities. The role will partner with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Risk, and Compliance teams to integrate security into applications, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on security professional experienced in cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, security monitoring, and compliance, with an ability to leverage modern cloud-native technologies and AI initiatives to strengthen security and enable business innovation.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At HMH, you will have the opportunity to strengthen cloud security and support GovRAMP initiatives while working with modern AWS and Azure technologies. You will collaborate with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Risk, and Compliance teams to protect critical applications and data, automate security processes, and drive meaningful improvements across the enterprise.
  
  
We foster a security-first, collaborative, and innovative environment that encourages continuous learning and professional growth. If you are passionate about cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, AI-driven security, and helping organizations securely scale in the cloud, we invite you to join us on our digital transformation journey.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities Include**

* Perform application security assessments using SAST, DAST, SCA, and manual testing.
* Identify, prioritize, track, and remediate application security vulnerabilities and findings.
* Conduct secure code reviews, threat modeling, and security design reviews for applications and new features.
* Perform web application and API security testing aligned with OWASP Top 10 and API Security practices.
* Integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and the SDLC.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement secure coding practices and provide remediation guidance.
* Support vulnerability triage, risk assessment, remediation, exceptions, and penetration-test findings.
* Develop and maintain application security standards, guidelines, procedures, and documentation.
* Support GovRAMP/NIST 800-53 control implementation, evidence collection, continuous monitoring, remediation tracking, and assessment readiness.
* Provide security guidance and awareness to developers and engineering teams.
* Plan, implement, and track initiatives that strengthen application security across the SDLC and GovRAMP compliance requirements.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or comparable cloud environments, including designing, implementing, and securing cloud and hybrid environments.
* Approximately 5 years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, or a related security engineering role.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security, CWE, and common application vulnerabilities.
* Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, vulnerability management, and application security testing tools.
* Experience testing web applications, REST APIs, and microservices, including authentication, authorization, session management, encryption, and secure API design.
* Experience with Burp Suite or similar security testing tools and secure code review practices.
* Knowledge of CI/CD and DevSecOps, including integrating security testing and controls into development pipelines.
* Working knowledge of cloud security and applicable security frameworks, such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.
* Experience supporting GovRAMP/NIST 800-53 security controls, including control implementation, evidence collection, continuous monitoring, assessment support, and remediation tracking.
* Hands-on scripting/programming experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar languages.
* Ability to analyze security findings, validate vulnerabilities, reduce false positives, prioritize risks, and communicate remediation recommendations effectively.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with developers, architects, DevOps, security, risk, and compliance teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience securing AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud environments, including cloud-native services and hybrid architectures.
* Experience supporting GovRAMP/NIST 800-53 initiatives, including security assessments, control evidence, continuous monitoring, and remediation activities.
* Experience with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and secure design practices for cloud applications and platforms.
* Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security, including image security, runtime controls, and workload protection.
* Experience with penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, or bug bounty programs.
* Experience automating security processes using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and cloud security automation, including security controls integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Relevant security certifications such as Security+, CEH, OSCP, CSSLP, or equivalent is advantageous.

The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
  
  
We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

title: Sr Security Engineer - 11917
description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.
  
  
**Why join Coupa?**

* Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
* Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
* Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
  
  
**The Impact of a Lead Security Engineer at Coupa:**
Coupa's Security Engineering team protects our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data at scale. As Lead Security Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader on the Security Engineering team — architecting and building cloud security controls, setting engineering standards, and partnering closely with Engineering, IT, and Compliance to ship durable, automated security tooling rather than one-off fixes. You thrive on ambiguity, sweat the implementation details, and take pride in solutions that scale across hundreds of accounts and services.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Architect and build multi cloud security controls across Coupa's cloud environment. VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, IAM policy design using least-privilege and permission boundaries, and Organizations/SCPs for guardrails at scale
* Build policy-as-code and IaC security guardrails and wire them into CI/CD as pre-merge and pre-deploy gates rather than after the fact reviews
* Harden containerized workloads - image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and runtime detection
* Write auto-remediation for cloud misconfiguration and drift so common findings close without manual ticket routing
* Own Vulnerability management program, act as the technical escalation point for security incidents and vulnerability findings - leading forensics, containment, and root-cause analysis using cloud-native and EDR tooling, and driving remediation to closure
* Partner with Risk & Compliance to translate audit framework requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) into concrete technical controls, and automate evidence collection by integrating cloud telemetry with GRC tooling
* Mentor other security engineers through design review, threat modeling, and code/architecture review; raise the technical bar for the whole team
* Own reference architectures, threat models, and runbooks for the security tooling you build; participate in and help improve the on-call rotation

**What You Will Bring To Coupa**

* 10+ years of security engineering experience, including significant hands-on work securing production cloud environments at scale, plus experience leading projects or mentoring other engineers
* Deep, hands-on AWS security expertise - IAM, VPC/networking, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and Organizations/SCPs; working knowledge of GCP or Azure security is a plus
* Production experience with Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and policy-as-code frameworks, plus container/Kubernetes security tooling
* Strong software engineering fundamentals - Python and/or Go, Git-based workflows, and building/maintaining CI/CD security integrations (SAST, DAST, SCA)
* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms and vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Qualys, Tenable) - building detections and workflows, not just consuming dashboards
* Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53) sufficient to translate control requirements into engineering work
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to write clear technical design docs and explain risk trade-offs to auditors and engineering leadership alike
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CCSP, CISA, or AWS/GCP security certifications
* Some international travel may be required

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

title: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Analyst
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Analyst, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Analyst specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Analyst on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.

title: Product Security- Embedded / IoT
description:
**Position**
Product Security- Embedded / IoT
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description: Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT**
**Experience:**
2 to 10 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products.
  
  
The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture.
* Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I²C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections.
* Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation.
* Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability.
* Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security.
* Ability to understand C/C++ code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts.
* Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers.
* Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks.
* Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces.
* Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact.
* Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions.
* Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact.
* Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks.
* Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products.

**Location:**
IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
  
  
**Time Type**
Full time
  
  
**Job Category**
Engineering Services

description:

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Microsoft Security Solutions
  
  

* Architect and guide implementation of Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Design Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and SOAR solutions, including data onboarding, analytics, automation, workbooks, threat hunting, and incident workflows.
* Design identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, and identity governance capabilities.
* Design data security and compliance solutions using Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and compliance capabilities.
* Design endpoint and device security capabilities using Microsoft Intune and associated security baselines.
* Define integrations across Microsoft security services, Azure, on-premises platforms, third-party security technologies, and IT service management platforms.

Security Architecture and Consulting
  
  

* Lead cybersecurity architecture assessments, advisory engagements, and transformation programs.
* Design enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles and customer business objectives.
* Develop high-level designs, low-level designs, reference architectures, security roadmaps, and implementation patterns.
* Assess customer security posture and translate security gaps into clear business and technology risks.
* Design identity, endpoint, cloud, network, data protection, and security operations capabilities.
* Advise technical and executive stakeholders on cyber strategy, governance, risk, and compliance.
* Align recommendations with relevant frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and customer regulatory obligations.

Pre-Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support account and sales teams in customer pursuits and strategic opportunities.
* Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* Develop Statements of Work, proposals, solution designs, assumptions, dependencies, effort estimates, and delivery approaches.
* Present proposed architectures and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.
* Identify opportunities for advisory, implementation, optimization, and recurring managed security services.

Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Provide architectural leadership from discovery through design, implementation, transition, and operational acceptance.
* Govern solution quality and confirm that delivery remains aligned with approved architecture and customer requirements.
* Manage technical risks, architectural decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and design exceptions.
* Review customer implementations and recommend improvements that increase security value and reduce risk.
* Mentor consultants, engineers, and junior architects, and contribute to practice capability development.

Service Innovation and Thought Leadership
  
  

* Create reusable reference architectures, delivery accelerators, templates, workshops, and technical enablement materials.
* Contribute field insight to Fujitsu cybersecurity service development and continuous improvement.
* Produce whitepapers, blogs, webinars, executive briefings, and other thought-leadership content.
* Stay current with Microsoft security, cloud infrastructure, AI security, regulatory developments, and industry good practice.

**Required Skills And Experience**
Technical Expertise
  
  
**Identity and Access Management:**
Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, PIM/PAM, identity governance, SSO, and federation.
  
  
**Security Operations:**
Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, SOAR, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, security monitoring, and analytics.
  
  
**Microsoft Defender Suite:**
Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and vulnerability management.
  
  
**Cloud and Platform Security:**
Microsoft Azure security, CSPM, workload protection, hybrid security architecture, and integration with third-party platforms.
  
  
**Data Security and Compliance:**
Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, data governance, and compliance management.
  
  
**Architecture and Risk:**
Security principles, enterprise architecture, threat modelling, risk management, control design, and security governance.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
Mandatory
  
  

* 10+ years of cybersecurity experience.
* 5+ years of Microsoft security architecture or engineering experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise security architectures and leading customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Experience developing SOWs, proposals, solution designs, delivery estimates, and technical presentations.
* Ability to communicate security gaps and associated business risks to executives.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, lead multidisciplinary teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within agreed scope.
* Flexibility to support customers remotely and on-site; travel may be required based on engagement needs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in MSSP, MDR, SOC transformation, security advisory, cloud transformation, or global delivery environments.
* Exposure to OT/IoT security, AI security, enterprise architecture, and security service development.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud, VMware, and hybrid infrastructure security.
* Experience collaborating with Microsoft sellers, partner teams, and customer technical stakeholders.

Certifications
  
  
Required or Expected
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or willingness to achieve an agreed Microsoft security certification within six months of joining.
* One or more role-aligned Microsoft certifications such as SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, or equivalent.

**Preferred**

* CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC, SABSA, TOGAF, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Postgraduate qualification in cybersecurity, technology, or business is advantageous.

Success Measures

title: Lead DevSecops Engineer
description:
Summary of This Role
  
  
Combines software development and IT operations practices which shorten the systems delivery life cycle and provide a continuous delivery platform and complements the efficiencies of Agile software development methods. Builds and maintains the tooling and infrastructure used to automate the release, deployment, and upgrade processes. Ensures continuous, high velocity delivery and automated deployment through the use of software provisioning, configuration management, source code management and/or team collaboration applications.
  
  
What Part Will You Play?
  
  

* CI/CD Pipeline Development
* Architect and implement automated build, test, and deployment workflows using tools like Harness.io and GitHub Actions.
* Continuously improve pipeline reliability, speed, and maintainability via templating, modularization, and best practices.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) pipelines using Terraform.
* Ensure consistent provisioning and configuration of cloud resources (compute, networking, storage, IAM).
* Operate and optimize components in AWS or Google Cloud Platform
* Monitor cost, performance, and security posture; recommend and implement improvements.
* Work hand-in-hand with application teams to onboard services onto CI/CD pipelines, define branching strategies, and automate release gates.
* Partner with security and compliance teams to bake in policies (e.g., vulnerability scans, secret management) into pipelines.
* Build reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to accelerate delivery across teams.
* Integrate testing frameworks (unit, integration, security) and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing) into workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures, infrastructure provisioning errors, or environment drift.
* Monitor and triage security vulnerabilities identified by platforms such as Wiz and Macroscope; partner with engineering and security stakeholders to drive remediation efforts.
* Collaborate with security teams to integrate automated vulnerability detection and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
* Configure and maintain secure and reliable log forwarding from application and infrastructure layers to observability platforms such as Splunk.
* Helps other developers on the team with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks
* Partner with development and other project teams to improve the systems process and provide the necessary support with day to day operations
* Migrate older technology implementations to modern a container/Kubernetes platform
* Ensure logs meet compliance, audit, and monitoring requirements; help define and enforce logging standards across environments.
* Primary contributions in Development, Testing Frameworks and Rollout.
* Works under the guidance of Lead Software Engineers, Tech Leads and Architects.
* Research trends in the current technology domain, discover new tools and garner the consensus for internal adoption
* Mentor and train junior and mid-level engineers on the team; assists with technical issues and onboard them to the frameworks

What Are We Looking For in This Role?
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical discipline
* Typically Minimum of 6 years years of experience in IT with expertise in complex technology solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with policy-as-code tools (OPA, policy frameworks).Exposure to security automation (vulnerability scanning, secrets management).
* Understanding of Git branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based development).
* GCP/Azure cloud certification
* SAFe certified
* Working with remote teams (onshore, nearshore, offshore)
* Experience with managing a large code base that is a mixture of legacy code and modern technology, preferably experience with moving legacy code to the cloud
* Experience with SF DX
* Experience with continuous integration build engines, such as Jenkins

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?
  
  

* Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).
* Job Complexity - Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.
* Supervision - Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

title: Information Technology Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

Travexpert Destinations is a customer-focused travel company specializing in personalized itineraries for solo travelers, groups, and families. With over 12 years of industry experience, the company creates customized travel experiences tailored to individual preferences, travel styles, and transportation choices, including rail journeys across Europe and beyond. The company focuses on seamless travel planning, attentive service, and end-to-end coordination to deliver memorable journeys and build lasting customer relationships.

**Role Description**

Travexpert Destinations is seeking a proactive and technically proficient
**IT & Digital Technology Consultant**
to manage and enhance the company’s IT infrastructure, website, and digital media platforms. This full-time, on-site role involves maintaining IT systems, implementing technology solutions, improving business processes, and overseeing the technical and operational aspects of the company’s digital presence.

The consultant will work closely with management, internal teams, and external vendors to ensure reliable IT operations, optimize digital platforms, strengthen online visibility, and implement technology-driven solutions that support business growth and customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure & Systems Management**

* Maintain and troubleshoot computer systems, networks, software, hardware, and other IT infrastructure.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable technology solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Manage software installations, system updates, user access, backups, and data security.
* Provide technical support to employees and ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations.

**2. Website & Digital Platform Management**

* Manage and maintain the company website, ensuring functionality, performance, mobile responsiveness, and user experience.
* Coordinate website updates, content changes, technical enhancements, and integrations with external developers or service providers.
* Monitor website performance and identify opportunities to improve navigation, lead generation, enquiry forms, and customer engagement.
* Manage relevant digital tools, CRM platforms, hosting services, and website analytics.

**3. Digital Media & Online Presence**

* Manage and maintain company digital media platforms and online business profiles, ensuring consistent branding and accurate information.
* Coordinate digital content publishing, scheduling tools, and platform administration in collaboration with the marketing team.
* Support digital marketing initiatives through campaign tracking tools, analytics, and performance monitoring.
* Maintain account security, access permissions, and administrative control across company-managed digital platforms.

**4. Digital Transformation & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and streamline business workflows using technology.
* Recommend and implement cloud-based applications, CRM systems, productivity tools, and workflow automation solutions.
* Explore integrations between the website, customer enquiry systems, and internal business applications.
* Support technology initiatives that improve travel planning, customer service, lead management, and operational efficiency.

**5. Data Security, Analytics & Reporting**

* Implement appropriate cybersecurity, data protection, backup, and recovery practices.
* Monitor IT systems, website analytics, and digital platform performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare reports on system performance, website activity, and digital engagement metrics.
* Maintain IT documentation, standard operating procedures, and technology usage guidelines.

**6. Vendor Coordination & Employee Support**

* Coordinate with website developers, hosting providers, software vendors, and external digital service providers.
* Evaluate technology solutions based on business requirements, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Train employees on IT systems, digital tools, and business applications.
* Document technical processes and ensure timely resolution of IT and digital platform issues.
